summary: Settings page: the Baidu Scholar interface checkbox is removed (only the Baidu search row remains, its key line unchanged; user_settings.baidu_scholar() is pinned off by BAIDU_SCHOLAR_OFFERED=False so a stored sourceBaiduScholar no longer enables the source; stored data and migrations untouched); a 获取 link beside the DeepSeek key (fixed https://platform.deepseek.com/api_keys, registered as DS-KEY-PAGE). Demo (tour): (1) library import runs the real import page and import code offline in the sandbox on a bundled three-record BibTeX sample (demo.import_options forces online=false and include_fileless=true, resolve runs inside the request, allow list limited to the sample flow, PDF upload and seeds stay 403); (2) selection questions on a bundled original English reading text (app/static/demo/reading-material.pdf, generated deterministically by scripts/make_demo_reading_pdf.py from demo_fixture.READING, registered as the local PDF of Attention Is All You Need in the sandbox): DemoApp.qa/translate answer from pre-written zh/en text matched to the selection (demo.match_selection), zero gateway calls; the assistant prefilling, labels, hidden cost switches; tour gets k1-k5 and i1-i6 (27 steps), clickOn, an import page boot. IPC allow list and packaged assets change, hence critical. .gitignore: *.pdf is ignored, so the one committed PDF (app/static/demo/reading-material.pdf) is un-ignored explicitly.
scope_note: Worktree settings-demo-extras, one commit on top of main b400029 (the onboarding-tour merge). The main checkout's uncommitted logo changes are not part of it.

budget_impact.rationale: The demo answers and translations are pre-written text (model=demo) from DemoApp.qa/translate; the sandbox gateway still raises on any call; the import runs offline (online=false, no OpenAlex). The only new link opens an address in the browser. No provider call, prompt, retry or quota changes.
budget_impact.before: demo without reading or import; Baidu Scholar switch in settings
budget_impact.after: demo with reading, selection questions and import at zero tokens and no network; no Baidu Scholar switch

additional_checks.command: browser run in the preview pane (source backend, empty data directory, 1280x820)
additional_checks.scope: full tour in Chinese/light and English/dark including selection, ask, translate, import of 3 papers; real database tables all 0; no console or server errors; see the evidence file for the steps and what was done instead of a mouse drag

open_risks: Not independently reviewed (critical class: IPC allow list and packaged assets).
The selection was made through a script (Range + mouseup) in the preview pane, not by a mouse drag in WKWebView/WebView2.
The reading material is English only (a Chinese text layer needs an embedded CJK font); answers, translation and questions follow the interface language.
Reloading in the middle of the reader steps (k2-k4) leaves the target absent; the step degrades to a centred bubble after 15 seconds and the person can continue.
platform.deepseek.com/api_keys is a signed-in page; only the link on the official docs page was checked.

Baidu Scholar adapter code, /api/source-test for baidu_scholar and their tests remain (switched on per test module); a stored sourceBaiduScholar stays in settings.json until the next save in the settings page.
